name: The Verge
description: Past the last beacon the charts go to guesses. One red dwarf, one cold moon with a single settlement dug into it, and - on a band nothing should be using - a signal that has been asking the same question since before the question had anyone to ask.

npcs.name: Watch-Hand Orel
npcs.greeting: This platform's the last thing the charts are sure of. I keep its lights on and log every hull that passes - two a year, counting yours. If you're going to the moon: they know you're coming. They've known for days.

default.label: Verge Anchorage
default.description: A single settlement dug into a cold moon at the edge of the charts. A paved plaza, a handful of prefab modules, and one light left on.

ambient.message: Someone rises from a bench by the market hall and stands very still, watching you cross the plaza. You know the way they stand. Walk over and press T.

start.text: You came. I wasn't sure the chain would hold all the way to you - or that you'd still be the kind to follow it. Hello, {pilot}. It's really me. Older, and I've been talking to something that isn't a person for a long time, but me.

options.label: You've been alive out here the whole time.

alive.text: Or close to it. The array's a kilometre under this plaza - Relay-era, maybe older, and it's been broadcasting one burst on a dead band the entire time. A question. I answered a scrap of it once and watched the charts around Tessellate redraw themselves overnight. I've spent the years since learning enough of its grammar to give a full answer - and being too frightened to.

options.label: What happens if you answer it fully?

choice.text: It opens. Lanes allowing for faster travel than any beacon, charts rewriting toward stars nobody's named - an invitation, or a door held for something on the other side. I've had the reply drafted for a year. But, I won't send it alone. You got the transmission. You came. So it's yours to call, and I'll stand by it either way.

options.label: Send the reply. We answer it - together.
Shut the array down. Some doors stay closed.

done.text: It's done. Whatever we set moving out here, we set it moving together. Come on - let's not watch it happen from the ground.

npcs.name: Anchor-Keeper Ludd
npcs.greeting: Nine of us live here and one of us lives under the plaza with a headset on. We bring Elian food and don't ask. You're the first hull to land here in two years - you'll be why Elian finally comes up or why they never do.
